visualReview.verdict: No new concrete art or runtime defect observed in the inspected native views.
visualReview.rootAcceptance: Recorded separately by root; this receipt does not impersonate the root reviewer.

coverageLimits: Four functions across three actors and two facings are explicitly forced presentation fixtures; real damage and defeat observations are separate.

Player placement, image-map availability, residual windup, pressure sample and synthetic viewport positions are declared fixtures. They do not prove input, projectile, network or complete campaign journeys.
Almost frontal view, sparse alpha 1–2 background debris, reddish fringe and nearly opaque source alpha 253 remain. No source cleanup or per-pose resizing was performed.
The neutralized state is 37.2 pixels high at the shared scale and inherits native alpha 0.3. Any scene occlusion must be assessed in the actual saved views.
Only the agreed final adaptation notice rows are excluded from the two HUD comparisons. Neighbor Q/R bodies and the two other ecosystem worlds have strict parent R comparators.
Reduced motion and asynchronous loader callbacks belong to the separate runtime test suite unless explicitly recorded here; no broad Canvas matrix for them is claimed.
Source hashes identify the files inventoried, not every transitive module. The source PNG is immutable.
No canonical caste, complete royal cast, CQ-05 audio, extended TR-0 campaign or global 1:1 fidelity is certified.
The uncommitted candidate was captured over exact R ded6ef34. A future committed delivery can inherit this evidence only if the captured production bytes are identical.

The role has no autonomous locomotion or illustrated attack. The generic native incoming-hit wrapper still pushes a living target by 3.6 pixels after the tested 12 damage; exact R and C telemetry match. Drawing does not cause this movement.

The neutralized body is partly covered by a royal guard, loot and particles at the final authored site. The isolated native 0.3-alpha view proves its shape; the world trace proves admission and expiry without promising complete visibility through other objects.

The first world-death camera-only assignment failed by 1.519276 pixels. The preserved name matrix places the sprite within 0.000012 pixel; the new three-instant native sequence confirms the corrected device without suppressing shake or increasing tolerance.
Synthetic culling positions observe a vertical extension at top and bottom. Left and right are already admitted by the parent-style base viewport; no horizontal extension is claimed.

The initial pressure 64 and direct native damage calls are explicit fixtures. Actual deaths reduce it by 16 each, unlock mother-1, and the normal phase term raises it to 16.225 after the observed interval.
Runtime-owner results of 64 / 64 and two causal mutants are separate evidence in runtime-freeze-v1.json. This Canvas task did not rerun that test group.
